title: fix(plugin-audit, service-messaging): boot-time system-table provisioning honours OS_SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC
body:
Fixes #22984

Clause-②: no (the seat cannot read it without a build: any new name on a package entry's declared surface, an accessor included, flips it; the dev measures on the built declaration closure and stops on a flip)

## What this changes

`OS_SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC=1`, or `ObjectQLPlugin`'s `skipSchemaSync` option, declares that a deployment's DDL is managed out-of-band. The engine's boot honoured it. `AuditPlugin.provisionSystemTables` and `MessagingServicePlugin.provisionSystemTables` did not, so a flag deployment got its system tables re-created at `kernel:ready` while the boot log said no DDL ran. The direction is the triage grade (comment 6121183235): the fix is in the provisioning plugins, and `syncObjectSchema` is not gated.

- **`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`** (the producer). `init()` publishes the `skipSchemaSync` value the plugin resolved (the option, else `OS_SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC === '1'`) on the engine instance it registers. It is the undeclared own property `skipSchemaSync`, keyed by the module constant `SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC_ENGINE_KEY`, which is not exported. The option's TSDoc gains one paragraph saying the value also governs the plugins' boot provisioning.
- **`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-plugin.ts`**. `provisionSystemTables` hoists its four objects into `objects`, then checks `bootSchemaSyncSkipped(engine)` first. That is a module-private probe, `engine.skipSchemaSync === true`. When it is set, the method logs one `info` line (`provisionSkippedLine`) and returns before any DDL or probe. The rest of the method is unchanged. One docblock sentence became false with this change and is corrected: "`OS_SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC` is NOT named: this method issues its DDL whether or not that flag is set". A new "Why the flag skips this provisioning" section is added.
- **`packages/services/service-messaging/src/messaging-service-plugin.ts`**. Same shape. The `objects` array now sits above the `syncObjectSchema` probe. Next comes the `bootSchemaSyncSkipped(engine)` early return with its one `info` line, then the unchanged `const sync = engine.syncObjectSchema; if (typeof sync !== 'function') return;` and the per-object loop.
- **`.changeset/22984-boot-provision-honours-skip-sync.md`**: `patch` for all three packages.

#22985 (queued, same messaging function) remains open. The shape it will meet is the one in the messaging bullet above.

## Measurements (the dispatch's assumptions)

**A1, confirmed** on `origin/main` `8e4a2302a`. Neither `provisionSystemTables` read the flag: the flag's only mention in either file was the audit docblock sentence above. `ObjectQLPlugin` held the resolved value in `private skipSchemaSync` and exposed no accessor.

**A2, confirmed for all twelve tables, so the skip is built in both plugins.** Measured through `os` itself (`packages/cli/bin/run-dev.js`, BASE tree `8e4a2302a`). `os serve` with `OS_MIGRATE_AND_EXIT=1` provisions a fixture app with `requires: ['auth']`. Every physical table backing the twelve objects is dropped. Then `os migrate plan --json` and `os migrate apply --yes` run.

| shape | `migrate plan` lists `create_table` | `migrate apply` creates |
|---|---|---|
| one database (`OS_TELEMETRY_DB=0`) | 12 / 12 | 12 / 12 (`Created/extended 12 table(s)`) |
| telemetry sibling (`sys_audit_log`, `sys_activity`, `sys_notification`, `sys_notification_delivery` and `sys_http_delivery` land in `boot.telemetry.db`) | 12 / 12 | 12 / 12, each in its own store |
| `OS_SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC=1` set in the plan and apply environment | 12 / 12 | 12 / 12 |

The tables: `sys_audit_log`, `sys_activity` (physically `sys_activity__r20261012`), `sys_comment`, `sys_comment_reaction`, `sys_notification`, `sys_inbox_message`, `sys_notification_receipt`, `sys_notification_delivery`, `sys_notification_preference`, `sys_notification_subscription`, `sys_notification_template` and `sys_http_delivery`.

**A3: the seam adds no entry-reachable name, so `Clause-②: no` holds.** The seam is the optional probe of the concrete engine: an undeclared instance property, with no public method, exported type or kernel-service contract. It was measured on the built declarations. The BASE `dist` declaration files (`.d.ts`, `.d.mts`, `.d.cts`) of all three packages were snapshotted before editing and rebuilt after. Each pair was compared raw, and again after the TypeScript printer with `removeComments: true`.
- Across all 10 declaration files, the comment-stripped declarations are IDENTICAL. The raw bytes differ only in TSDoc: the new option paragraph in objectql's `index.d.ts` and `index.d.mts`, and the private method's docblock in plugin-audit and service-messaging. That raw difference also proves each `.d.ts` was rebuilt from this source.
- POSITIVE CONTROL: the rebuilt `util-Ch_WDmDU.d.ts`, which holds `declare class ObjectQL`, reads as DIFFER at that line once one `readonly skipSchemaSync: boolean;` member is injected. A first control attempt anchored on `index.d.ts` matched nothing (0 anchor hits) and was discarded as void.

**A4: the skip line is `info`.** Under the flag nothing is degraded. The operator declared DDL out-of-band, and nothing claims persistence it does not have, so the AGENTS.md "Degradation log levels" question answers No. If a table is in fact missing, the writers report it on first use (`audit-writers.ts` logs the missing-table write at `error`). The line names every skipped object, the flag and `os migrate apply`.

**A5, held.** Under the flag `provisionSystemTables` makes no engine call in either plugin. The audit unit pin asserts the recording engine saw zero calls: no `syncObjectSchema`, `getDriverForObject`, `getDefaultDriverName` or `find`.

## Integration-level reading of the triage pin

`os serve` with `OS_MIGRATE_AND_EXIT=1`, `OS_TELEMETRY_DB=0`, `OS_LOG_LEVEL=info`, and the A2 fixture:
1. Boot 1 with the flag unset.
2. Drop `sys_comment_reaction` (audit) and `sys_inbox_message` (messaging).
3. Boot 2 with `OS_SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC=1`.
4. Boot 3 with the flag unset, as the CONTROL.

BASE `8e4a2302a` shows the defect in both plugins. The card left the messaging half unmeasured.

    after boot 2 (flag set): sys_comment_reaction=true sys_inbox_message=true
      INFO Skipping schema sync (OS_SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC=1) — assuming DDL is managed out-of-band; registered 75 object schema(s) with their drivers WITHOUT DDL
      INFO AuditPlugin: system tables provisioned — sys_audit_log→com.objectstack.driver.sql, sys_activity→com.objectstack.driver.sql, ...

This branch:

    after boot 2 (flag set): sys_comment_reaction=false sys_inbox_message=false
      INFO [messaging] sys_notification, sys_inbox_message, sys_notification_receipt, sys_notification_delivery, sys_notification_preference, sys_notification_subscription, sys_notification_template, sys_http_delivery NOT provisioned at boot — the boot's schema sync is skipped (`skipSchemaSync` / OS_SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC=1), declaring this deployment's DDL managed out-of-band, so this service issues none either. `os migrate apply` creates any that are missing (`os migrate plan` lists them as `create_table`).
      INFO AuditPlugin: sys_audit_log, sys_activity, sys_comment, sys_comment_reaction NOT provisioned at boot — the boot's schema sync is skipped ...
    after boot 3 (flag unset): sys_comment_reaction=true sys_inbox_message=true

## Tests

New pins in each plugin's test file (`audit-plugin.test.ts`, `messaging-service-plugin.test.ts`):
- **Flag set.** No DDL is issued, and the audit pin sees no engine call at all. The lazy-table model's table stays absent. Exactly one `info` skip line names every object, the flag and `os migrate apply`. Nothing about provisioning is logged at `warn` or `error`.
- **CONTROL.** With the flag published as `false`, every object is provisioned exactly as before.
- **Seam table, with the REAL `ObjectQLPlugin` as producer** (`registerProtocol: false`, the engine's `syncObjectSchema` spied). Option `true` skips. Option unset with `OS_SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC=1` skips. Both unset provisions. Option `false` with `OS_SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC=1` provisions; this is the row that discriminates, because a plugin that read the environment itself would skip there.

Ablations. Each used `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with an EXIT/INT/TERM trap, and each restore was proven by blob hash equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.
- **Consumer, audit.** Early return disabled (`if (false && bootSchemaSyncSkipped(engine))`): 3 red, 18 green. Red were the flag-set pin (`expected [ 'getDefaultDriverName', …(8) ] to deeply equal []`) and the two skip rows of the seam table (`expected "syncObjectSchema" to not be called at all, but actually been called 4 times`).
- **Consumer, messaging.** Same mutation: 3 red, 12 green (`… called 8 times`).
- **Producer, objectql.** The publish was replaced by `void SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC_ENGINE_KEY;` and objectql rebuilt (14/14). `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs --absent` proved the publish gone from all 14 built files. Result: audit 2 red, 19 green; messaging 2 red, 13 green. In each suite the red rows were the two skip rows of the seam table. The restore leg rebuilt, the preflight found the publish back in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs`, and the tree was clean.
- **A discarded first producer run.** It deleted the statement outright, and its build exited 1 (13/14: the now-unused constant). That run was discarded even though its direction matched.

Suites at `8afbc3b90`:
- `@objectstack/plugin-audit`: 47 files, 761 passed. Typecheck exit 0; the test layer goes through `tsconfig.test.json`, and `audit-plugin.test.ts` is in that program.
- `@objectstack/service-messaging`: 48 files, 540 passed. Typecheck exit 0; `--listFiles` includes `messaging-service-plugin.test.ts`.
- `@objectstack/objectql` (`vitest run --project local`): 406 files, 7936 passed. Typecheck exit 0.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 68 commands over the 6 changed paths (merge base `8e4a2302a`). All 68 ran at `8afbc3b90` and every one exited 0. The `--ran` verdict reads 68 run and 0 NOT-MEASURED, derived from the recorded exit codes. Three gates needed a prerequisite first and were re-run on the same HEAD:
- `check-engine-split-ratio --days 90` refused on the shallow clone; history was deepened to 2026-07-07.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` needed built output.

**Lint, narrowed and proven.** eslint `--no-inline-config --format json` over the 5 changed `.ts` files reported 5 files, 0 errors and 0 warnings. eslint's own config covers all 5 (no ignore notice) and excludes the changeset (`File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied.`). The repo's config enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` run is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **Same family, NOT fixed here (reported to the seat).** `PackageServicePlugin.start()` creates `sys_packages` with a raw `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` under the flag too: measured dropped, then re-created by a flag boot. `os migrate apply` does not create it: `plan` does not list it, and after apply it stays absent. Honouring the flag there would leave a flag deployment without `sys_packages`. That is the decision A2 reserves for the maintainer.
- The objectql boot prints its `Skipping schema sync (OS_SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC=1) …` info line twice per flag boot. This is cosmetic and not filed.
- The branch was not merged with `origin/main` before opening. Six commits (63 files) landed since `8e4a2302a`, none of them in this diff or in `serve` / `migrate`. CI runs the merge ref.
